11!/(4!4!2!) = 34,650.

Σ (-1)^(a+b+c) C(3,a)C(3,b)C(1,c)
(11−a−b−c)!/[(4−a)!(4−b)!(2−c)!] = 2,016,

where a,b,c count linked adjacencies among I, S, and P respectively. Thus the probability is

2016/34650 = 16/275 ≈ 0.05818.
